title: Cross-implementation: each endpoint parses the other's envelopes; identical inputs give identical bytes
summary: Offline, both endpoints build every vector of docs/test-vectors.json that has inputs and run every receiver case; the bytes and the dispositions are compared with each other and with the vector file. Live, both endpoints exchange envelopes of all five priorities, header-only envelopes, envelopes with ACK_REQ, envelopes of 30000 and 65536 bytes (Endpoint A) and 65000 bytes (Endpoint B), an unprotected envelope with an unknown frame type and a protected command with an unknown frame type; each endpoint's offline tool then decodes the other endpoint's logged envelopes and compares every header field, the length and the SHA-256 with the sender's own record.

criteria.text: For every vector with inputs, Endpoint A and Endpoint B build the same bytes, equal to the vector file; for every receiver and SEC-B case both give the expected result and reason

criteria.name: a-vectors
criteria.text: Endpoint A's vector run passes every check

criteria.name: vector-comparison
criteria.text: The comparison program finds no difference

criteria.name: a-crosscheck
criteria.text: Endpoint A decodes every envelope Endpoint B logged as sent with the same field values, and Endpoint B received every envelope A sent byte-identically

criteria.name: b-crosscheck
criteria.text: Endpoint B decodes every envelope Endpoint A logged as sent with the same field values, and Endpoint A received every envelope B sent byte-identically
Every envelope handed to ION is received by the other endpoint
Every received envelope is byte-identical to the envelope handed to ION
Each endpoint accepts every envelope of the other implementation
The protected command with an unknown frame type is executed
